arms.D3: as D2, up to 8192 steps; validate every 512 steps on GAR-valid dense silver spell F1; patience 3 evaluations; keep best-on-GAR-valid checkpoint
arms.R: ha_target=anchors, train_d=False, fraction .5, 2048 steps; SoccerNet records = dense-record anchor_y/anchor_full_y (records with >=1 H/A anchor, order of load_dense_records); rebuild of the adopted recipe

common.old_data: 13 historical TRAIN caches of the two non-held-out providers (old.load_old(fold))
common.soccernet_train: 45 TRAIN games (dense silver records, recipe v1)

hard_rules: no SoccerNet data/weights committed; no organizer public GT; no GAR test evaluation; no promotion; no push

metrics.dev_cells: 15 development cells (5 matches x clean, feed_like corrupt_1/2); provider-held-out fold model on its provider's matches; official metrics; cost-3 Viterbi (frozen supervised.decode); equal-provider mean; spell F1, macro F1, D-F1 (P/R), short-spell recall, five IoUs, predicted-spell counts, per-provider rows
metrics.gar_valid: dense silver GAR-valid (9 games, 2191 records, all of valid); native-rate probabilities by interpolation, cost-3 Viterbi, official metric code; spell F1, macro, D-F1, short-spell recall; mean over the 3 fold models. Viterbi implemented in C bit-identical to supervised.decode (tested). Validator keeps per-record native fps (jitter 1e-7 across games; scoring uses the mean). Not subsampled.
metrics.references: adopted pooled width-96 ensemble and pooled teachers scored on GAR-valid only (they saw the dev providers)

phases.C1: arms R, D1, D2, D3 x 3 folds (12 fits), seed 2026
phases.C2: best C1 recipe at fraction 0, .25, .75, 1.0 (reuse C1 for .5); 12 fits. If the best C1 recipe is D3, C2/C3 use fixed steps = median of the three C1 best_steps rounded to the nearest 512 (minimum 512), no early stopping, to bound compute (the C1 D3 row stays the early-stopped reference); the .5 row is then the D3 C1 fits only for reference and the fixed-step .5 fits are added to keep the sweep like-for-like
phases.C3: best recipe+fraction on nested SoccerNet subsets of 11 and 22 TRAIN games (sn.nested_games); 45 = existing; 6 fits
phases.C4: re-fit only the final winner with seed 2027 (teacher seed 2027), 3 fits; score each seed and the probability-average ensemble (average native probabilities, then decode)

scaling: slope 22->45 reported as delta per doubling (log2) on GAR-valid spell F1 and dev clean spell F1

selection_rule.choose: among arms passing the guards (R passes trivially), highest GAR-valid spell F1 (mean of 3 fold models); tie-break dev clean equal-provider spell F1
selection_rule.guards: relative to arm R of the same phase: for every provider, dev clean D-F1 and clean macro F1 >= R - .02; dev feed_like equal-provider spell F1 >= R - .01 (soccernet_capacity.guard_checks)
selection_rule.not_used: dev clean spell deltas vs R and vs saved baseline .626425 are reported but never used to select

statement: Frozen before any Phase-C fit. Changes go in a separate amendment file.
stop_rule: NaN/impossible scores or label leakage -> stop, fix, amend, rerun affected fits; if total runtime far exceeds ~6 h, finish current phase and report
